title: Very Heavy
text:
Very Heavy. This thing turns your king comforter into a weighted blanket. It is SO heavy! It has ties around the inside so you can properly attach it. The velvet stuff is super soft and cozy.
But I hate it. The black edging is added on to the outside, so it is more of a trim than part of the cover or shams. I didn’t even see the black edging in the photos, so I was really surprised at how prominent it is.
The shams and duvet cover close with invisible zippers. Invisible zippers are really uncomfortable and make this super soft fabric look odd. So I feel like I spend a lot of time hiding the zippers. It just makes it even more odd. With the weird black edging and the hidden zippers, this just never looks natural and not weird. It always has an “off” look. And it is way too heavy for me.
